title: ID0413410-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312571675/07] Charging Station Faulty
description:
Reported behavior/issue: I'm reopening this ticket because the existing one was closed
(ID0447221). An intervention took place on 09/09 by Franck Le
Gal. A CFAST and the XF3 router were replaced.
The charging station has been faulty again since 10/09. I visited
the site yesterday. The station restarts process gets stuck at 30%,
which indicates an issue with the PLC.
I’m attaching some photos taken on site and a screenshot off SCB
before my onsite visite.
Could you please forward this ticket as soon as possible to the
French after-sales service team?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0413410-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312571675/07] Charging Station Faulty CRM:02832000424
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0449404
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Engie
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / PN 312571675/07
Charger ID / Serial No.:
u4TYtM
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution: Charger is in Failsafe Mode. I checked the charger remotely via SSH, and I believe the Failsafe mode is caused by router XF3. The charge ris online on SCB, but it seems that the router is not accessible from charger point of view. For example, the router webUI is not accessible. It seems that the inetrnal router of XF3 it is blocked.
I would suggest to check router XF3, check if webUI is accessible onsite, reconfigure it or in case replace it.
Let me know if remote support is required.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
With kind regards,
